Market today: The tech/chip sector is seeing mixed signals around Nvidia's Jensen Huang – some recovery in Asian tech post his "departure" (per one headline), but also governance questions on his "return." This creates uncertainty for your concentrated book.

Your holdings: Your leveraged ETFs are taking a beating. SOXL is down a brutal -80.77%, MUU -64.16%, and SPAL -51.17%. These deep losses are amplified by margin, making them critical to address. Your stops on these positions are clearly not working.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the broader chip sector sentiment, especially around Nvidia's leadership. Also, review the effectiveness of your stops on all leveraged positions.

Bottom line: Your primary focus must be on managing the extreme risk in your deeply underwater, leveraged tech/chip positions.
plays: SOXL is down -80.77% with a stop at 200. This stop is completely ineffective; consider trimming to reduce exposure.
MUU is down -64.16% with a stop at 31.6. This leveraged ETF is bleeding heavily; review your risk tolerance and consider trimming or adjusting the stop.
SMCI is down -44.1% with a stop at 37.3. Respect the stop at 37.3 or consider trimming to manage the significant loss.
